records.title: Manual closeout after one non-default-base merge
records.summary: One #368 closeout reports manual issue closure after PR #369 merged to a non-default base; not a universal GitHub rule.
records.applies_when: Inspecting linked-issue status after a PR to a non-default branch merges.
records.does_not_apply_when: Assuming the behavior for default-branch merges or other untested GitHub configurations.
